source.title: Ashenvale Mission II: Defeat Treants
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Defeat treants there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 7 Vengeful Ancients in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
